offering_description.value: Franchises a network of independently owned on-demand staffing offices that place temporary and direct-hire blue-collar workers with businesses. Franchisees recruit, screen and dispatch workers to client sites, and the franchisor provides the brand, systems and support.

primary_services.value: temporary staffing; direct-hire placement; on-demand labor dispatch; franchise support

customer_segment.value: B2B: businesses in light industrial, manufacturing, warehousing and construction needing temporary or direct-hire workers

end_markets.value: light industrial; manufacturing; warehousing and logistics; construction; hospitality

revenue_model.value: licensing or royalties: franchise royalties and fees paid by franchisees based on staffing sales

value_chain_position.value: service provider: supplies temporary workers to client businesses through franchised offices; brand owner: licenses its staffing brands and operating system to franchisees

geography_served.value: US national: franchised offices across many US states

specialization.value: niche specialist: single line of franchised blue-collar and light industrial staffing

distribution_channels.value: other: independently owned franchised staffing offices serving local business clients

regulatory_exposure.value: low: normal business rules and employment laws governing staffing and franchising

notes: Business description and franchise-network details are from general knowledge and may not reflect current operations.
